Overview

Thiruvananthapuram is a city in Kerala with a population of 1,680,000. The capital of Kerala, a coastal city known for its beaches, backwaters, ancient temples, and space research center at VSSC. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
